models_evaluated: knowledge graph plus retrieval-augmented generation framework

links.outcome: Ablation of retrieval augmentation on concept extraction F1, AUROC and AUPRC
links.effect: Removing retrieval augmentation changed F1, AUROC and AUPRC by 0.029, 0.034 and 0.031; none reached statistical significance. Removing the knowledge graph produced larger, significant drops.
links.quote: Removing retrieval augmentation produced changes of 0.029, 0.034, and 0.031 for these measures, none of which reached statistical significance.

unlisted_practices: Integrating a patient-safety knowledge graph with LLM reasoning to improve concept extraction
Fine-tuning an LLM with low-rank adaptation for patient safety concept extraction

screen.reason: The study conducts component ablation analyses specifically comparing performance with and without retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and knowledge graph grounding for clinical patient safety reasoning, along with expert usability/plausibility assessments.

primary.practice: retrieval-augmented generation and knowledge graph grounding
